narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**Safe to rename, but only in the JS.** 1291 hits in 94 files.

| Area | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` identifiers | ~1075 | yes |
| SQL strings in `repo/*.js` | 125 | no |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | no, all applied |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | no, regenerated |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | no, public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` | 5 | left key only |

The DB column is still `account_id`. [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) maps internal to public. Repos also write `account_id` inside JSON payloads.

Next: sign off scoped to `services/*` variable names.
